Review the actual garment construction

Inner silicone-grip hem

The supplied customer photograph shows the grip strip and hem stitching. Specify strip width, placement and elastic tension, then check comfort and movement on the fit sample.

Academy artwork and sublimation

The reference features a multicolor back crest, sleeve lettering and wave graphics. Use your own authorized branding and approve printed samples before production.

Raglan and multi-panel construction

Short raglan sleeves and shaped side panels define the reference silhouette. The construction brief calls for four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching; confirm the stitch type and skin-side finish on the sample.

The feedback describes one customer’s order. Materials, sizing, artwork and order terms for your own project are confirmed separately.

Buyer questions

Can my academy replace the FLOW artwork with its own branding?

Yes. This garment is a customer-project reference. Develop your own academy logo, panel artwork, colors, labels and packaging with TONTON; submit artwork you are authorized to use for review.

What does the silicone hem do?

The inner grip strip is intended to help the lower hem stay in position. Its effect depends on fit, body movement and the clothing worn underneath. Check placement, tension and comfort with a physical sample.

What are the fabric composition and GSM?

Exact fiber percentages and fabric weight are confirmed in your approved material specification. Request a fabric swatch and fit sample before bulk production.

How are the wave graphics printed?

The supplied brief specifies digital sublimation. Approve a printed fabric sample for color, stretch appearance and wash performance. No permanent no-fade or no-crack guarantee is stated.

Is this design competition approved?

No governing-body approval is claimed. Verify your event’s uniform, color and logo rules before approving the artwork.

Prepare your academy brief

Share your academy logo, preferred colors, short-sleeve fit direction, estimated quantities, size allocation and target delivery date. TONTON reviews material choices, grip-hem details, artwork and sample requirements before confirming a quote.
